title: Mod repair
summary: Repairs mods that a game update broke: models that no longer load, sound mods that leave parts of the game silent, and subtitle mods that miss the game's new lines. The original files are kept, and every repair can be undone. Sound bank and subtitle repair by x402.

intro: A game update can stop mod resources made for the earlier version from loading, or leave parts of the game without their sound or text. A repair updates a mod's models, sound banks and subtitle tables to the game's current ones: the game's current structure stays, and what the mod replaced is put back. The original files are kept, and every repair can be undone. Deploy afterwards to apply the changes in game.
